<policies>
    <inbound>
        <base />
        <rate-limit-by-key calls="__RATE_LIMIT_CALLS__" renewal-period="60" counter-key="@(context.Subscription?.Key ?? context.Request.IpAddress)" />
        <set-header name="Authorization" exists-action="delete" />
        <set-variable name="migration-api-mode" value="@{ var mode = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-API-Mode", (string)null); return string.IsNullOrEmpty(mode) ? "default-v1" : (mode.Equals("v1", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "v1" : (mode.Equals("legacy", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "legacy" : "invalid")); }" />
        <trace source="openai-v1-migration" severity="information">
            <message>OpenAI migration request routed by API mode.</message>
            <metadata name="api_mode" value="@((string)context.Variables["migration-api-mode"])" />
            <metadata name="request_id" value="@(context.RequestId.ToString())" />
        </trace>
        <choose>
            <when condition="@(((string)context.Variables["migration-api-mode"]).EndsWith("v1"))">
                <set-backend-service base-url="__V1_BACKEND_URL__" />
                <rewrite-uri template="/openai/v1/chat/completions" copy-unmatched-params="false" />
                <authentication-managed-identity resource="https://ai.azure.com" client-id="__APIM_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID__" />
            </when>
            <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["migration-api-mode"] == "legacy")">
                <set-backend-service base-url="__LEGACY_BACKEND_URL__" />
                <rewrite-uri template="/openai/deployments/__DEPLOYMENT_NAME__/chat/completions?api-version=2024-10-21" copy-unmatched-params="false" />
                <authentication-managed-identity resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com" client-id="__APIM_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID__" />
            </when>
            <otherwise>
                <return-response>
                    <set-status code="400" reason="Invalid API mode" />
                    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                        <value>application/json</value>
                    </set-header>
                    <set-body>{"error":{"code":"invalid_api_mode","message":"X-API-Mode must be v1 or legacy when provided."}}</set-body>
                </return-response>
            </otherwise>
        </choose>
        <set-header name="X-API-Mode" exists-action="delete" />
    </inbound>
    <backend>
        <retry condition="@(context.Response != null && context.Response.StatusCode >= 500)" count="__RETRY_COUNT__" interval="__RETRY_INTERVAL__" delta="1" max-interval="4" first-fast-retry="false">
            <forward-request buffer-request-body="true" />
        </retry>
    </backend>
    <outbound>
        <base />
    </outbound>
    <on-error>
        <base />
    </on-error>
</policies>
